description: Discard uncommitted file changes in a Git project's working tree.

project.description: Git project reference — an OID or a name.

changes.description: File paths whose uncommitted changes should be discarded.

status_checksum.description: Checksum from ``GET /api/v2/projects/{project_id}/status``, sent as the ``x-git-status-checksum`` header; the request fails if it does not match the project's current status.

examples.user_query: Discard all uncommitted changes in the 'sales-analytics' Git project for files in the 'dashboards' folder, ensuring the status checksum matches.
examples.notes: This call discards all uncommitted changes in the 'dashboards' folder of the 'sales-analytics' project, ensuring the operation proceeds only if the status checksum matches the current project state.

examples.user_query: Can you discard changes to 'config.json' and 'settings.yaml' in the 'marketing-insights' Git project?
examples.notes: This call discards uncommitted changes to 'config.json' and 'settings.yaml' in the 'marketing-insights' project, ensuring the operation is consistent with the provided status checksum.

examples.user_query: Discard uncommitted changes in the 'data-models' project for the files 'schema.sql' and 'mappings.json'.
examples.notes: This call removes uncommitted changes to 'schema.sql' and 'mappings.json' in the 'data-models' project, ensuring the operation only proceeds if the provided checksum matches the current project state.

description: Retrieve a single Git Integration project by ID.

owner_id.description: Include the ID of the user who created the project.

tag_names.description: Include an array of all local Git tag names.

examples.user_query: Retrieve the Git project with ID 'abc123' and include its commits.

examples.user_query: What is the current branch name for the Git project with ID 'xyz789'?

examples.user_query: Get details of the Git project 'proj456', including its owner ID and local tag names.

description: Retrieve a Git project's current status checksum.

examples.user_query: Retrieve the current status checksum for the Git project 'dashboard-reports'.

examples.user_query: What is the current status checksum of the Git project with ID '12345abcde'?
examples.notes: Retrieves the status checksum for the Git project identified by the OID '12345abcde'. This is useful for ensuring the project state is up-to-date before performing Git operations.

examples.user_query: Get the status checksum for the Git project named 'analytics-engine'.
examples.notes: Obtains the current status checksum for the 'analytics-engine' Git project. This checksum reflects the project's working directory changes, branch, and HEAD commit.

description: List the Git Integration projects accessible to the current user.

favorites_only.description: Return only projects the current user has favorited.

last_commit_message.description: Include the subject/body of each project's last commit.

last_commit_date.description: Include the timestamp of each project's last commit.

owner_id.description: Include the ID of the user who created each project.

detached_head_hash.description: Include the current commit hash for projects in a detached HEAD state.
